note: Inside the same fictional Atlas pavilion as S48 (the chronochamber), designed after the approved CS06_1/CS06_2 cutscene frames (light wood-panelled walls, the steel console plate with the four port symbols, the amber emergency lamp above it, the big window to the west with the real Rotunda complex). Camera ~1.6 m high, looking straight at the back wall; horizon y ~470; the back wall meets the floor on y ~700 (~126 px per metre there), Viktor's table front stands on y ~790. Perspective s(y) = (y - 470) / 545 (same as the other interiors). Left: the long steel console plate with the four ports (circle, cross, square, triangle) and the emergency lamp above it; centre: the big window showing the Rotunda (dark station wings on stilts, the stone base, the glass drum with the red ring) and Viktor behind his wooden table with the desk lamp and his untouched glass of water; right: the free-standing restore console with its big button and four lamps, the door back to the service bay. The table got a solid front panel in a zoomed local edit (v2). The walk polygon leaves out the restore console (foot y ~805).
